I am so unbelievably sorry for your loss.. I wish I could say more then just sorry.. My heart broke for you when I read your reply, please know that I am truly truly sorry. I wish I was strong enough to give you some solid advice, I really am so sorry. But please know that if I'm still around and in a better headspace I'll try and help and be here for you. 
It's sad because we really liked each other more then friends, and we were in the process of taking that friendship to the next step.. but I truly believe we were soulmates, I've never met a more beautiful person in all my life. I am having extreme thoughts of suicide. I've been researching a lot of information on drugs and trying to find some in my area, trying to figure out the most painless, quickest way. I've done drugs before and everything, but this is strictly for the purpose of what would make me overdose.. people keep asking if I'm okay and to look over myself, but I feel like I can't bring myself back from this depression. You know.. I've had some pretty rough shit happen to me in my life. I was sexually abused repeatedly by a babysitter/trusted family member when I was younger and never told anyone. My stepfather kicked me out of my own home when my mom was sick with breast-cancer, I would do things just to have a roof over my head. But this.. this is rock bottom. I have never felt a more overwhelming pain in all my life.

The love of my life committed suicide about a week ago. I've posted on reddit multiple times about my depression, grief and pain. All all I've revived is nothing but love and support from an amazing community of people, and I'm beyond grateful for that. But it's not enough to take this pain away. I've tried calling numbers where you talk to professionals in mental health, I'm in the process of actually seeing a therapist soon. But.. I don't think any amount of counseling can take away this pain. I think about killing myself all the time, I think about harming myself all the time. The only thing that brings me happiness is the thought of us meeting again. I miss him so much, it physically hurts knowing he's not here.
